reasons: All 8 ACs map to ac1-ac8 nodes; recipe-run status=pass 19/19.
AC3/AC4/AC6/AC7/AC8 upgraded from identifier greps to behaviour proof via the owning Jest suites, after a grep assert was found passing on a stale renamed identifier.

The one visual claim (market-not-found error screen) is proved live over CDP with a registered screenshot; reverting the gating fix would still pass ac1-ac5 but the analytics claim is anchored to a screen proven to render.
better_version_guidance: Event counts remain Jest-only: the harness exposes no analytics-capture action, so no node observes an actual MetaMetrics payload in the running app.
Live nodes require caffeinate -disu; on an idle machine Chrome's compositor suspends and the run aborts before writing artifacts.

graph_integrity.reason: Linear Protocol v1 workflow; all 19 nodes reachable from gate-repo-root to teardown-end; validated with mm-harness run --plan (0 findings).

ac_coverage.reason: Each AC has ac<N>-prefixed nodes; recipe-coverage.md documents 8/8 PROVEN plus live UI proof, and states the three known limits rather than omitting them.

evidence_fit.reason: Non-visual claims use behaviour (Jest) and contract asserts; the single visual claim carries a screenshot registered by the runner.

flake_risk.reason: Jest nodes run with --runInBand after two userEvent-timeout flakes under parallel load; both were confirmed non-regressions by idle re-runs. Live nodes depend on a healthy CDP runtime, which is the residual risk.

contextual_findings.message: The predecessor recipe's ac4 node asserted the source string 'hlFeeRate: closeFeeRate', renamed to currentFeeRate in d6893f8f80. It failed on first execution this session - a stale assert, not a product regression. Motivated the move to behaviour nodes.

A failed mm-harness run leaves the previous run's summary.json in place; two aborted runs this session left a stale pass 18/18 that would have read as success. Verify startedAt before trusting a recipe verdict.

suggested_recipe_delta: If the harness gains an analytics-capture action, add nodes asserting actual PERPS_SCREEN_VIEWED / PERPS_UI_INTERACTION payloads in the running app so event counts leave the Jest layer.
Extend live proof to the geo-block notice once per-trigger `source` is implemented, so screen_type=geo_block_notif has a rendered-screen anchor like the market-not-found state.
